title: Simulator Runtime on Transformed Inputs
statement: For every Boolean word $z$, the fixed simulator computes, on the front transformation of $z$, the one-bit output whose value is the indicator of whether $z$ belongs to $\mathrm{EXPCOM}$. Its running time is exactly $d(|z|+2^{|z|}+1)^d$, where $d$ is the simulator's degree parameter.
replaced:
For every Boolean word $z$, the fixed simulator halts on the front transformation of
$z$, outputs the one-bit word indicating whether $z$ belongs to $\mathrm{EXPCOM}$, and
does so in exactly $d\bigl(|z|+2^{|z|}+1\bigr)^d$ steps, where $d$ is the simulator's
fixed degree parameter.
